SYNTHETIC QUESTIONNAIRE SOURCE: REPEATED CONSUMPTION TEMPLATE
SECTION Food consumption
Repeat instruction: Repeat the following item template for each listed food product.
Repeat values: maize, rice, beans, and cooking oil.
Repeat entry: F1.
ITEM F1
Question template: Did the household consume [FOOD PRODUCT] during the last seven days?
ITEM F2
Question template: What quantity of [FOOD PRODUCT] did the household consume?
ITEM F3
Question template: What was the value of [FOOD PRODUCT] consumed?
Repeat routing: After F3, start F1 for the next product. After the final product, exit the repeat.
